name: zhud_container_set_child_flags
description: HudUiContainer::SetChildFlags applies a child flag mask to every child while preserving bit 0x10.
known_limits: Binary Ninja currently records a reconstruction limitation for this helper because HLIL keeps the inverted low-byte test rather than the direct preserve-bit expression; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HUD container source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4bc8d0 validates iterating the child list from childHead, writing childFlags when existing bit 0x10 is clear, and writing childFlags|0x10 when it is set.
The native smoke verifies SetChildFlags updates all children and preserves each child's existing 0x10 flag.
